newsitem.title: USA: Capital One issues $600 mln certificates.
newsitem.headline: Capital One issues $600 mln certificates.

text.p: Capital One Bank Thursday issued $600 million of floating-rate class A asset-backed certificates through Capital One Master Trust, Series 1996-2, said J.P. Morgan, the lead manager of the offering.
The certificates, which have an expected maturity of December 17, 2001, were priced at 10 basis points over one month LIBOR, J.P. Morgan said.
The certificates are rated Aaa by Moody's Investors Service, AAA by Standard & Poor's Rating Group and AAA by Fitch Investors Service.
The assets of the trust are receivables generated from MasterCard and Visa credit cards, the company said.
The credit enhancement for the transaction is provided by $82,500,000 of floating rate class B certificates and a collateral indebtedness amount of $67,500,000, J.P. Morgan said.
Chase Securities Inc, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, and UBS Securities were co-managers for the offering, J.P Morgan said.
